title: Separation and Gluing of Explanations on Sites of Dynamical Systems
summary: We construct a Grothendieck site whose objects are Mealy machines over definable sets in an o-minimal structure and whose coverings are jointly surjective families of definable open immersions. On this site, we define presheaves of explanations -- systems equipped with an interpretable interface, parameterised by a ``judge.'' We prove that the behavioral presheaf (quotienting by observable output equivalence) is separated: a global explanation is determined by its local restrictions.
